summary: EKSO is a self-hosted help desk ticketing system combined with a project and issue tracker. It is designed to help teams manage incoming support requests alongside internal tasks within a single workspace. The software is distributed as a containerised image.
goodFor: It is suited for small teams or evaluators looking to trial a combined ticketing and issue-tracking environment using container deployment.
watchOut: The project is proprietary, has no recorded tagged releases, and shows no recent commit activity, carrying significant abandonment risk.
deployNotes: As a Docker deployment, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
